train.note: no constant action survives 300 decisions on seed13 (best constant dies at 259), so these survivals are not something a constant can produce

verdict.reading: the arm learned something that pays on the training tape and costs on the held-out tape: overfitting to one bullet pattern, not a general dodging skill

limitations: one train window and one dev window: this is a transfer test, not a seed study
72 cumulative training episodes is 36% of the prereg's 200
dev n=10 gives a wide interval; the sign of the dev change is the robust part
the overfitting reading assumes seed11 and seed13 differ mainly by bullet RNG, which R2/R3 established for the three original tapes but not specifically here

the eval runner reused one output filename, so the 12-episode raw dev file was overwritten by the 72-episode run; the 12-episode values are taken from R29's frozen evidence rather than from the raw file
